[NERR.8.1] These surface from `ds_engine_load_dsc`. The detail names the failing
atom, the byte offset, and the violated RDSC rule.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `DS_ERR_DSC_TRUNCATED`  | file too short; a declared atom length exceeds remaining bytes |
| `DS_ERR_DSC_BAD_MAGIC`  | the first atom is not a `DscHeader` ([RDSC.1.4]) |
| `DS_ERR_DSC_VERSION`    | the artefact is outside the runtime's version series |
| `DS_ERR_DSC_DECODE`     | an atom body fails protobuf decode |
| `DS_ERR_DSC_SEMANTIC`   | a decoded body violates a per-atom rule |
| `DS_ERR_DSC_DANGLING`   | a reference to an entity absent from the artefact |
| `DS_ERR_DSC_DECOMPRESS` | a body declared a compression codec other than `COMPRESSION_NONE`; the runtime carries no decompressor ([RDSC.4.5.1]) |
| `DS_ERR_DSC_CAPABILITY_ABSENT` | the artefact requires a capability this build was compiled without; the detail names the capability, as a value of `proto/capabilities.proto#Capability` ([RDSC.16.2.7]) |
